term.label: bidirectional_promoter_lncRNA_gene

definition.text: A non-coding locus that originates from within the promoter region of a protein-coding gene, with transcription proceeding in the opposite direction on the other strand.

comments: This is a gencode term. See GitHub Issue #408. Synonyms "bidirectional promoter lncRNA gene" and "bidirectional_promoter_lncRNA_gene" added 23 April 2021 by David Sant. See GitHub Issue #506.
